limitations: This bounded candidate requires independent review of method and preparation sufficiency. The original reports its own LOI tests and exact values but does not state an LOI instrument, standard, dimensions, repetitions or conditioning. It gives the cotton supplier, areal density and treated add-on but omits the fabric-finishing bath, temperature, duration, cure and wash protocol. FR synthesis conditions are not assigned to fabric finishing. Figure 4 caption independently supplies air and 10 °C/min for fabric TG; no start/end acquisition temperature is inferred from the axes. Exact residues at 600 °C are explicit in the prose. Initial decomposition temperatures lack a threshold definition and remain raw; approximate DTG-stage temperatures remain raw with their qualifiers. Later 2014 APPCABT paper (DOI 10.1007/s11814-014-0095-2) repeats the control tuple and explicitly cites this treated FR as intermediate M. That later control and M comparison must remain reuse-held; no 2014 assay or preparation method is transferred to this source. No LOI-from-char formula appears in the original.
